tasks.instruction_text: I'm scoping a AWS workload for a customer in us-east-1 (N. Virginia) — set up a quote for S3 Standard, override the default usage to 10 TB storage for the month, and pin the Business Support tier since this is a regulated tenant.

Could you put together a S3 One Zone — Infrequent Access quote? Always-on 1-month workload — use 1 TB storage — and bill it out of us-east-2 (Ohio), the Developer Support tier is fine, we don't need anything fancier.
Need to estimate S3 Intelligent-Tiering (frequent) sitting in us-west-2 (Oregon) at about 500 GB storage. We're on the Basic Support tier anyway.
Configure the calculator for S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval in us-west-1 (N. California) — usage around 500 GB storage per month and we're already on the Enterprise On-Ramp tier for the FedRAMP tenant.
What's the projected monthly bill for S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval in ca-central-1 (Canada) doing 1 TB storage, with the Basic Support tier attached?
Quick check — if I put 10 TB storage through S3 Glacier Deep Archive in sa-east-1 (São Paulo), on the Basic Support tier, what does the monthly estimate come to?
Hmm, what would S3 Standard cost me in eu-west-1 (Ireland) for a 10 TB storage monthly commitment if I add the Business Support tier on top? Just want the number.

Pricing exercise for a finance review: configure the calculator for S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval in eu-central-1 (Frankfurt), override usage to 500 GB storage, leave support at the Basic Support tier, then tell me the all-in monthly total — they want it for the budget doc.

OK so I need to estimate S3 One Zone — Infrequent Access running in eu-west-2 (London) for one month — use 1 TB storage — and we're on the Developer Support tier; set it up in the calculator and give me the monthly figure.

Hey, can you set up an estimate for 10 TB storage out of eu-north-1 (Stockholm) on S3 Glacier Deep Archive and tell me the monthly cost? We're on the Basic Support tier, but if it's over $1000/month we'll probably want to revisit.
